brief: First apartment after graduation. I still sleep on a mattress on the floor and the moving boxes are everywhere. Make it feel like a calm, grown-up bedroom without painting.

scan.summary: Small narrow rental bedroom with floor mattress on right, white desk and chair under window, freestanding wardrobe and open clothes rack on left, and cardboard moving boxes by the door.

light.direction: diffuse daylight from back-wall window plus overhead ceiling light

plan.title: Calm First-Apartment Bedroom

slots.look: ivory plain cotton duvet cover set with subtle waffle texture and matching pillowcases
slots.placement: Dress the existing floor mattress centered against right wall with duvet folded neatly and pillows at head end.
slots.why: Instantly makes floor mattress look intentional and grown-up and brightens the corner.

slots.look: large low-pile beige wool-look area rug in solid plain weave
slots.placement: Lay flat in center walkway between bed, desk and wardrobe with long side parallel to bed, leaving doorway clear.
slots.why: Warms the bare wood floor, defines sleep and work zones, and softens acoustics for calm.

slots.look: large framed abstract landscape print in soft sage and cream with light wood frame
slots.placement: Hang centered on empty right wall above bed at eye level when standing, long side horizontal.
slots.why: Fills big blank wall without painting and adds calm focal point over bed.

render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 5 are the reference photos of products 1 to 3, in order.
1. Replace the rumpled gray duvet with product 1: Ivory Diamond Matelasse Coverlet (bedding), real size 173 x 218 x 3 cm (width x depth x height). Dress the existing floor mattress centered against right wall with duvet folded neatly and pillows at head end. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Ivory diamond matelasse coverlet and shams draped on bed, ruffled edges, geometric stitched diamond texture, soft wrinkled cotton. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Geometric Wool Area Rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 0.8 cm (width x depth x height). Lay flat in center walkway between bed, desk and wardrobe with long side parallel to bed, leaving doorway clear. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile rug in light beige wool with subtle embossed geometric medallion pattern and textured wool surface. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Abstract Waves Canvas Wall Art (wall art), real size 91.4 x 3.8 x 61 cm (width x depth x height). Hang centered on empty right wall above bed at eye level when standing, long side horizontal. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Horizontal rectangular canvas with layered wavy abstract brushstrokes in off-white, slate blue and charcoal gray with soft blended texture. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: stacked cardboard moving boxes. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
